binary_acceptance: Music swaps to the tension track during a raid (threatTier>=2) and back when clear.

audiobank_additions.field_dangerBgm: public AudioClip dangerBgm -- loopable danger/tension bed
audiobank_additions.field_dangerSource: private AudioSource dangerSource -- 4th independent source, 2D, loop=true, starts vol=0
audiobank_additions.field_crossfadeCoroutine: private Coroutine _crossfadeCoroutine -- stops prior fade on rapid tier flip
audiobank_additions.method_PlayDangerMusic: public void PlayDangerMusic() -- fades dangerSource in / bgmSource out over ~1s; null no-op if dangerBgm unassigned; idempotent via _dangerActive
audiobank_additions.method_StopDangerMusic: public void StopDangerMusic() -- fades bgmSource in / dangerSource out over ~1s; stops dangerSource after fade; idempotent
audiobank_additions.method_DangerCrossfadeCoroutine: private IEnumerator -- lerps both volumes using Time.unscaledDeltaTime (pause-safe); snapshots start volumes for mid-fade reversal safety

musicdirector_design.bootstrap: [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] -- hidden DontDestroyOnLoad GameObject, FindFirstObjectByType guard, mirrors RainSoundDriver pattern exactly
musicdirector_design.state_guard: int _lastTier = -1 sentinel (like RainSoundDriver._lastKind bool); only acts on tier transitions, not every frame
musicdirector_design.null_safety: AIDirector.Instance null -> silent idle; AudioBank.Instance null -> silent idle; both checked per-frame

danger_wav.character: tense low-drone (55/82.5/110Hz minor-5th stack + 0.15Hz vibrato) + tension shimmer (900Hz narrow-band noise AM at 1.8Hz) + 4 slow percussive hits (~0.4Hz rate, 60Hz kick with pitch-drop + noise burst)
danger_wav.loop_integrity: 0.8s cosine fade-in + 0.8s cosine fade-out at endpoints for click-free AudioSource.loop=true

scene_wiring_flag.method: Same Inspector wiring workflow as sfxBuild/sfxAlert/sfxAmbient/sfxMine/rainLoop -- QA wires via SceneSetup.Game.Audio.cs ForceImport
scene_wiring_flag.consequence_if_missing: PlayDangerMusic/StopDangerMusic are null no-ops; wiki #8 cannot verify

crossfade_throttle.time_basis: Time.unscaledDeltaTime (pause-safe -- crossfade continues even if player pauses mid-raid)
